project_info.theme: Toyota Veloz Cross all-out promotional offer with Bovoi mascot
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, orange, white, chrome silver, city gray

main_subject.detail: A high-energy sales poster with Toyota logo top left and headline 'CHOT TOYOTA VELOZ CROSS BO VOI Lo het'. A blue elephant mascot in an orange striped polo and beige shorts stands on the left making an OK hand gesture. A white Toyota Veloz Cross is displayed on the right in a front three-quarter view. Above the car is a large chrome-framed scoreboard showing three orange offer panels: 'UU DAI 100% Le phi truoc ba', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT 0%', and 'TANG 01 NAM Bao hiem than vo'. Bottom right has an orange CTA button 'MUA NGAY'. Bottom-left script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Glossy dealership campaign poster with mascot branding, metallic offer-board styling, and polished city backdrop

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Veloz Cross all-out promotional offer. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Veloz Cross beside a cheerful blue elephant mascot in an orange shirt. Background is a bright city scene under a blue sky with a large metallic offer board. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'CHOT TOYOTA VELOZ CROSS BO VOI Lo het', three offer panels 'UU DAI 100% Le phi truoc ba', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT 0%', and 'TANG 01 NAM Bao hiem than vo', plus the orange CTA 'MUA NGAY' and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal automotive sales composite with mascot and 3D promo-board treatment, bright commercial automotive lighting, glossy reflections and chrome highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
